name: QAM File Link
description: One-way OFDM/QAM file transfer — DMT engine ported from audiomodem (VA3JFL): QPSK–4096-QAM, RS(255,223) FEC, pilots + SFO tracking, callsign beacon lock. 8 profiles from 500 Hz / SSB 2.4 kHz through NBFM, 9k6-jack and WBFM to stereo-bonded cable, 96 k and 192 kHz — ~0.5 kbit/s to ~1.3 Mbit/s measured.
author: Ham Radio Web Studio
